iter_algonauts_timelines: iterate over all Algonauts 2025 fMRI timelines for friends and movie10 tasks across subjects
load_algonauts_fmri_data: load fMRI data from an Algonauts 2025 timeline as a Nifti2Image with the specified key
get_algonauts_transcript_path: get the transcript file path for a given Algonauts 2025 timeline task and movie chunk
load_algonauts_events: load a DataFrame of fMRI, video, and word events from an Algonauts 2025 timeline transcript
download_algonauts_dataset: download the Algonauts 2025 competitors dataset to the specified directory using Datalad
